gate.connectBody: Chat is powered by Snapie. Connecting signs a one-time login challenge with your posting key. No transaction, no cost.
gate.cannotSign: Your current login can’t sign the chat challenge. Use Keychain, HiveAuth, PeakVault or Ledger.
gate.needsAccountBody: It unlocks with everything else once you graduate.
gate.loginBody: Sign in with your Hive account to send and receive messages.

markRead.nothingToClear: No conversations to clear. The count may be stuck server-side.
markRead.stillUnread_one: Still showing {{total}} unread after clearing {{count}} chat.
markRead.stillUnread_other: Still showing {{total}} unread after clearing {{count}} chats.
markRead.stillUnreadNoMatch_one: Still showing {{total}} unread after clearing {{count}} chat. The server reports a count but no matching conversation.
markRead.stillUnreadNoMatch_other: Still showing {{total}} unread after clearing {{count}} chats. The server reports a count but no matching conversation.
markRead.notSignedIn: Chat is not signed in. Reconnect chat and try again.
markRead.sessionExpired: Chat session expired while clearing. Reconnect chat and try again.
markRead.serverRejectedVisible_one: Server rejected all {{count}} request (ids from the visible list)
markRead.serverRejectedVisible_other: Server rejected all {{count}} requests (ids from the visible list)
markRead.serverRejectedServerMap_one: Server rejected all {{count}} request (ids from the server's own unread map)
markRead.serverRejectedServerMap_other: Server rejected all {{count}} requests (ids from the server's own unread map)
markRead.failed: Could not mark everything as read
